trimming_hazard_analysis: HAZARD ANALYSIS (MAXLEN Pending Entry Trimming): In Redis Streams, running XADD with aggressive MAXLEN ~ N trims messages from the head of the stream. If a message is currently claimed by a worker and tracked in the Pending Entries List (PEL), trimming that message removes its payload data from the stream. When the lease expires, a supervisor running XAUTOCLAIM or XCLAIM will receive the message ID, but the message field payload will return nil. This causes silent data loss and unrecoverable worker crashes. PRODUCTION RULE: Never set MAXLEN smaller than peak burst volume + 24-hour SLA retry window (> 50,000 entries). Use stream-level retention policies rather than aggressive message-level XDEL.

consumer_group_semantics.enqueue_command: XADD yorvyn:stream:jobs MAXLEN ~ 50000 * payload <json> priority <int> tenant_id <tenant>
consumer_group_semantics.claim_command: XREADGROUP GROUP reconstruction_workers <worker_id> COUNT 1 BLOCK 2000 STREAMS yorvyn:stream:jobs >
consumer_group_semantics.dead_letter_command: XADD yorvyn:stream:dead_letter MAXLEN ~ 10000 * original_id <id> tenant_id <tenant> reason <reason>

retention_and_trimming_policy.xdel_policy: STRICT_PROHIBITION_ON_IMMEDIATE_XDEL: Do not execute XDEL immediately after XACK. Immediate XDEL destroys audit trails and interferes with PEL recovery. Use stream-level MAXLEN trimming instead.
retention_and_trimming_policy.acknowledged_retention: Preserved in stream for 24 hours or up to 50,000 entries via MAXLEN ~ 50000.
retention_and_trimming_policy.pending_entry_list_pel: Unacknowledged messages remain in PEL until recovered via XAUTOCLAIM or transferred to DLQ upon exceeding 3 delivery attempts.
retention_and_trimming_policy.dead_letter_retention: Retained for 30 days in yorvyn:stream:dead_letter with MAXLEN ~ 10000 for forensic debugging.

durability_and_high_availability.failover: Redis Sentinel with 3-node quorum or Google Cloud Memorystore Multi-AZ with automatic failover
